title: Kitsune Slayer vs Skeleton Hound
description: A female warrior with purple hair and a kitsune mask leaps mid-air while chained to a skeletal wolf-like creature with glowing red eyes. In the background, a white rabbit samurai stands on a gnarled tree branch holding a katana, surrounded by a dark forest, purple roses, stone lanterns, and a glowing purple portal containing a black cat silhouette.
prompt: A dynamic action scene of a fierce female warrior with long flowing purple hair, wearing a kitsune mask and green pants, leaping while wrapped in red chains attached to a snarling skeletal wolf with glowing eyes. A white rabbit samurai in black armor stands on a tree branch holding a katana above her. Dark mystical forest with purple roses, stone lanterns, glowing purple portal with a black cat shadow inside, dramatic lighting, white dripping paint effects at the edges.
